description: Wind Turbines - Scotland is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. This point dataset represents every known (and/ or applied for) wind turbine over 15m (to turbine tip) in the country. It includes details (where known) of planning reference, height, status (i.e. approved, developed, withdrawn), number of turbines on the site etc. Some local authority areas (e.g. Coverage: Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Addresses, Buildings, Human health and safety, Renewables, Wind. The portal shows 2025-10-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
